thread:
Oma: heads-up: we shipped a console label change that now shows "active_preference=v2" even when calls keep landing on v1 due to tenancy pinning. Customers are confused.
Ravi: can you paste headers? we rely on `x-rw-requested` and `x-rw-executed` to reconcile.
Oma: trace: `x-rw-requested: rw-model-cc-v2` / `x-rw-executed: rw-model-cc-v1` / reason: `pin-sticky`.
Leah: suggestion: make console show 3-line compact state: "Config: rw-model-cc-v2 | Effective: rw-model-cc-v1 | Reason: pin-sticky" with a small "why" link.
Ravi: billing note: if we keep attributing quota to executed variant, tenant metrics drop unexpectedly. Propose keeping quota attributed to requested tag but tag infra billing with executed variant. That matches product expectations.
Oma: agree. Also add a small amber microstate: "config != effective" with hover text "effective variant will change after routing TTL or manual unpin".
Leah: I'll mock the badge. Ops-bot: can we sample full traces for 0.2% of pin-sticky fallbacks for debugging?
Ops-bot: sampling toggled: fallback_trace_sample=0.2% for group=cc-routes.
Ravi: I'll add telemetry fields `requested_variant`, `effective_variant`, `fallback_reason` and a nightly job to reconcile requested_quota vs executed_usage.
Oma: add a precedence doc snippet: token_header -> tenant_override -> route_default -> global_default. That was ambiguous.
Leah: action items: Leah (badge mock + tooltip), Ravi (telemetry + reconcile job), Oma (spec + customer comm).
